notes.title: First announcement! What will you get when ProBoon gets released?
notes.content:
ProBoon is an enhanced Doom Clone or sprite-based FPS being made with Unreal Engine 4.

This is what you WILL get in the future:

3 episodes with 10 levels each
Implementations of Doom II's weapons and enemies including the almighty Super Shotgun and BFG
Multiplayer cooperative play
Deathmatch, including Free For All, Team Deathmatch or 1on1
A 4th episode with its own game mode, Invasion, taking inspiration from Stronghold (mod), Complex Doom Invasion (mod) and Killing Floor (game). Play it alone or online with your friends
Big levels with hundreds of monsters and weird architecture
Tons of gibs and blood
Easy to use server browser and server hosting capabilities
Spectator and demo recording capabilities
Speedrun mode with integrated chrono

But this will only come after a period on Early Access.

When will the game get released as Early Access?

That's yet to be determined ːsteamsadː

I'm going to make a sticky post on the Community Hub with some links that will tell you where can you see more about the development progress.

I make regular updates and you can give feedback.
